duplicate_block.basis: real D runs are whole duplicated months (lengths [28, 31, 61, 62]); a block of 7+ days tests the L1 threshold, the upper end is the longest single-month run (two-month runs are two blocks)

stuck_value.basis: real K flags mark isolated days, not streaks; the longest natural streak of identical positive values in the real series is 5 days, so injected stuck episodes start above it
